description: List audience comments and Google Business Profile reviews across every brand this login holds (Studio and Pro), tagged with each brandId and brandName alongside merged open/replied/review counts. Ideal for agencies triaging all clients at once. Changes nothing.

kind.description: Filter across every brand by type: "all" (default), "comment", or "review".

limit.description: Maximum items to return across all brands (1 to 200; 50 when left out).

provider.description: Optional network key such as "bluesky", "instagram", "facebook" or "google".

status.description: Filter across every brand by status: "open" (default), "replied", "archived", or "all".

name: brands_inbox_list
title: List inbox across all brands
